log.t: Silverton. The moot is tonight, under a full moon, and nobody in town knows.
log.label: WALK OUT THE DOOR
log.out: the game begins; the Snoot lights at the moot that night

log.t: The Weigh-House board has a true word on it, for an anchor pin.
log.label: PAY THE PIN
log.out: the Snoot, listed

log.t: Pete's Five are in the Warrens' wet.
log.label: BRING THEM HOME
log.out: Pete's page: the Sheet, Grease

log.t: The forty-gold tail: the cloaker in the deep gallery, and Dace, who wants to go down.
log.label: ESCORT HIM AND TAKE IT DOWN
log.out: his pick: the Cloak of Displacement, or the Sheet, Mirror Image

log.t: The Halfway Inn. Second watch. A wagon comes in, children behind a glamour.
log.label: WAKE THE PARTY
log.out: everyone goes out; Katarina runs inside when steel comes out, and gives you her book the day after

log.t: Morning at the lake. Doran draws from it in front of everyone and drinks. The road north.
log.label: WALK NORTH
log.out: Silverton by evening; Urtusk walks out of his door: the scales lit, the stair drained, the one law

log.t: The stair behind the Warrens is dry. Down the cut door, along the hallway: somebody is at the dead. Hask, the wheelwright, two crewmen.
log.label: VIVIAN KNOWS THEM
log.out: Persuasion 13: they go, owing you; the sack dropped; Ingrith comes

log.t: You hold the night crew's sack.
log.label: KEEP IT
log.out: Brann names it at the lamp, once

log.t: The Burial's base ring: Audun's shield, released by the ledger; Asmund's gear, the dead's.
log.label: TAKE ASMUND'S GEAR
log.out: unlawful: Ketil takes it back at the door, renown down a piece

log.t: Ingrith has given you the front door. Up the dwarves' stair and down the Sunshaft: the king stands at the vault door.
log.label: LOOK HIM IN THE EYE, AND WALK THE ROAD WITH HIM
log.out: he leads

log.t: Down the road to First Lamp: a cut seal, gricks in the dark, a truesilver seam. Ulf and three troopers.
log.label: WALK ON
log.out: First Lamp held

log.t: The roper on the causeway across the great cavern. Nothing on the road knows if you fought it.
log.label: FIGHT IT

log.t: Second Lamp, across the great cavern. Thyra's report: Halldor's unit is pinned in the north cut.
log.label: THE NORTH CUT
log.out: five phase spiders, two troopers at your side; Halldor found

log.t: The drain under Second Lamp, under a weighted grate.
log.label: FIGHT IT

log.t: Halldor, found, wounded.
log.label: LAY ON HANDS (LYMEN)
log.out: ten of the pool

log.t: Halldor and his wounded, and the king, back up the road to Solskaft, past a relief column.
log.label: THE LAMP'S CIRCLE
log.out: no day; home; the king trusts you in his halls (his 10-12: "I need to review the circle of teleportation mechanics")

log.t: Ingrith needs the count of what the treasury sent to Deepholm. The only count is Androit's father's mine records.
log.label: GET THE PAGE
log.out: Idony reads everything; her price is not silver; the dwarves' answer; the page to Ingrith

log.t: Aldwin at the chapel: a dying woman says she was Asmund's wife, and a child was hidden in the Shaft Rows the week the gate sealed.
log.label: FIND THE HEIR
log.out: Old Hob's hint, Signy the rope-maker (Investigation 14 without it), Ingrith, the rite at Asmund's wedge; renown +1

log.t: Ragna can reverse the siphon and give the drained stair back its water, and its keeper, if you hold the stair for three nights.
log.label: HOLD THE STAIR
log.out: three nights at the stair (his 10-12: "should use the keepers map"); the stair is water again

log.t: The one who built the siphon got away. The night crews' tools are made at Brennan's forge.
log.label: HAND HIM TO INGRITH
log.out: the lift

log.t: The tariff board: the last surface goods ever tolled through Deepholm's gate, a caravan off the Coldridge route. Mical keeps manifests.
log.label: TAKE THE COPY TO MICAL
log.out: the caravan was never lost; Tobin Thorne has a line after

log.t: Halldor is on his feet, and he knows where the nest is. In the muster yard he asks.
log.label: WE COME
log.out: the nest is on

log.t: The nest: the north cut off the road short of Second Lamp, and past the neck. Cocoons in the walls, a brood chamber at the back.
log.label: BY THE CIRCLE TO SECOND LAMP, THEN THE CUT
log.out: no day on the road; the nest crushed; the first rest after brings Ulf's runner: the drow have taken Third Lamp
